inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed conference/journal papers and refereed workshop proceedings
ArXiv and other preprints with clear methodology and reproducible artifacts
Tool/project technical reports and GitHub repositories when accompanied by evaluation or source
Datasets, benchmarks, and public testbeds relevant to NetOps evaluation
Papers in English with verifiable bibliographic metadata
exclusion_criteria: Marketing materials or non-technical blog posts without reproducible details (exclude unless primary-source technical docs exist)
Non-English sources unless an English translation or summary is available
Opinion pieces lacking empirical or methodological substance
Duplicate versions where a verified primary source (conference/journal) exists
date_rationale: Prioritize literature from ~2018–2026 to capture recent advances in LLMs, tool-augmented agents, and AIOps while still including earlier foundational works (e.g., NetKAT, early verification tools) when they are methodologically relevant. The rapid evolution of LLM-based methods since 2020 makes recent papers especially important for mechanisms, mitigations, and benchmark validity.
